author: Brian Hioe
title: Taichung Mayoral Debate Emphasizes International Prestige
content:
THE TAICHUNG MAYORAL debate was held on November 17th. The two primary candidates were Ho Hsin-chun of the DPP and Johnny Chiang of the KMT. Ho was first to speak, followed by Chiang.

Ho began by criticizing Chiang and outgoing KMT Taichung mayor Lu Shiow-yen for attempting to convince the public falsely that the DPP would end subsidies to the elderly. Ho then went on to point to Taichung’s growing role as Taiwan’s second-largest city, but that issues involving traffic jams and poor transportation infrastructure were increasingly visible. This included addressing congestion on highways, as well as finishing the MRT Blue Line, and increasing international links through the Taichung International Airport. Likewise, Ho stated that there needed to be more subsidies and government policy to assist young people and provide them with opportunities. Ho suggested that the KMT administration of Taichung had stalled progress, but that, in government, she would be able to allow for coordination between the central government and local government.

Johnny Chiang stressed his love of Taichung, as well as his successes in the past in winning international productions to visit Taichung to film. Chiang stated that he was motivated to improve Taichung in running for office, and that he hoped for Taichung to become an internationally esteemed city. This would allow local Taichung products to go abroad. Chiang, too, stated that Taichung must become a smart city through the incorporation of AI with automation. To this extent, Chiang also stated that he hoped to speed up commutes in Taichung, so that residents had more time, and that young people needed opportunities. Chiang stated that he hoped to allow young people to feel that having children was not a burden and that they did not have to make a choice between their work and having children, as a result of which he would seek to renovate education facilities in Taichung. Chiang claimed that he already had a blueprint for implementing changes.

When questioned by experts in the Q-and-A section about further developing Taichung, Ho stressed plans to expand venues for baseball and entertainment, so as to connect Taichung with international touring for large-scale performances. Chiang touted the accomplishments of his predecessor, Lu Shiow-yen, in terms of developing venues, as well as exercise centers. Chiang stated that such development would continue, as well as that he would continue Lu’s emphasis on sustainable development. When asked about priority policies, Ho again stressed transportation, while criticizing lack of progress and the waste of money due to slow progress on transportation infrastructure. Chiang, contrastingly, stressed urban safety and the health of the citizens, including a focus on boosting and allowing more access to vaccinations, as well as promoting exercise. Chiang also compared Taichung to LA in terms of development and suggested that the growth of the city would need to take patterns of urban development into account.

In closing statements, Ho stressed bipartisanship and that she would seek to help all residents of Taichung regardless of political views. Ho stated that she hoped Taichung could be a safe urban environment for children and the elderly, and that young people could find jobs they enjoyed and which could support themselves.

Chiang thanked supporters and stated that he hoped to build a better Taichung with them. Chiang stated that he hoped to see more hi-tech jobs in Taichung and that Taichung could become a place where young people would not have to leave the city for opportunities. Chiang, too, stated that he hoped to develop museums and cultural activities for young people.

One notes that between Ho and Chiang, both emphasized similar needs for the city. There was a large degree of overlap between the two’s policy proposals, though Chiang sometimes focused more on a vision for Taichung rather than specific proposals. Chiang also managed to cite the accomplishments of his predecessor, Lu Shiow-yen, without being reliant on appeals to her legacy. But Chiang was perhaps the better orator in the debate and, in many ways, the race is his to lose if he is able to coast off of Lu’s legacy.

author: CNT Sevilla
title: Entre la ignorancia y maldad
content:
“Definición: del latín definitio, -onis.

 […]

2.- f. Proposición que expone con claridad y exactitud los caracteres genéricos y diferenciales de


algo material o inmaterial.”


Definir es la asignatura pendiente de la sociedad capitalista actual. Bueno, no exactamente. Atender a las definiciones con exactitud y responsabilidad lo es. Las palabras como Feminismo, Poliamor, Política, Estoicismo, etc… Son una marabunta de ideas arremolinadas en la mente de cada cual que han sido manoseadas por tantos y cuantos idiotas hemos ido dejando opinar a nuestro alrededor, siendo muy pocas (o ninguna) las veces que hemos permitido que alguien avezado/a y conocedor/a nos ilustrase en ello. Esto no ocurre sólo con grandes ideas sacadas de algún manual de filosofía para 2º de bachillerato. Esto ocurre con las cosas más tontas y rutinarias de nuestras vidas.


Es en las definiciones cuando realmente encontramos la raíz de cada tema y nos forjamos una visión responsable y madura del mismo.


No soy filólogo, y aunque me divierte como al que más el debate de dónde nacen las palabras (¿surgen de la necesidad social o derivan a ésta?), lo que no se puede evitar reconocer es que existen y delimitan algo. Si vas a una página cualquiera del diccionario y eliges una palabra al azar, como la de la cita más arriba, su definición te dirá lo que es, y a la misma vez lo que no es. Esto cobra sentido cuando lo piensas durante un momento: especifica lo que es, y, por ende, lo que

no

 es.


Pero entonces ¿por qué según a quién preguntes sobre una definición te dice una cosa y otra? ¿Estás diciendo que todos somos unos ignorantes? ¿Significa que para ser una persona responsable debería conocer todas las definiciones de todas las cosas?


Pues es que la cosa está entre la ignorancia y la maldad, sinceramente. Aunque no me refiero sólo a la nuestra.


Decía George Lakoff en su libro «No pienses en un Elefante», que toda palabra tiene en nuestro cerebro un marco cognitivo. Propio al cerebro de cada cual. Así que cuando alguien te habla de la Libertad, pues a cada cual le sale un conjunto personal de ideas. El concepto de Libertad no es igual el que tiene un niño palestino que sobrevive en el West Bank a los bombardeos de los colonos sionistas, que el concepto de Libertad que maneja una mujer blanca adinerada de Washington DC. Y como no son iguales, cada cual reacciona a las palabras de diferente forma, sí.


Esto es inevitable y además no es malo per se. Quicir, todos nos vemos abocados a vivir, experimentar, errar y asumir; y todo esto enriquece nuestros marcos de cada una de las palabras que usamos (y también en cada idioma que usamos). Es parte de la plasticidad cerebral, y nos da margen para mejorar.


PERO.


El problema llega cuando no somos diligentes a la hora de gestionar dichos marcos y subcontratamos nuestras ideas por las de alguien más, en específico, alguien más tonto o malvado.


Durante años vamos apartando trabajar en las definiciones de las cosas complejas. O durante la ESO, o en la facultad, o en las discusiones familiares. Es que cansa. Y surgen en debates demasiado personales. Nuestros marcos cognitivos personales chocan con los de nuestra interlocutora/o, pero difieren en cosas tan sutiles y complejas que el debate se complica, y claro; ¿quién quiere tener debates sesudos un domingo por la tarde estando en casa de mamá para comer? ¿Quién quiere utilizar el tiempo de descanso tras un turno de 9 horas para discutir con su pareja sobre el alcance de la cultura machista en el ámbito de la investigación farmacéutica? No es culpa nuestra, la vida tiene muchas cosas por hacer y la media de personas trabajadoras bastante tenemos con mantener la poca cordura que manejamos. Suele ser más fácil transformar estos debates en discusiones socráticas enfocadas en el “o gano yo o él”, o ver un vídeo en una red social que suene a cómo yo pienso sobre algo.


El ignorante


Y he aquí el problema. Cuando en lugar de leer la definición de lo que es y no es el tema de se habla, pues dejamos espacio a que cualquiera nos deje sus ideas en nuestros marcos. Es decir, cambiamos nuestras experiencias, opinión y libre pensamiento por las ideas de otra persona. Y la amplia cantidad de veces, sin siquiera macerarlo o pasar nuestras conclusiones por el Departamento de Montaje. Bombardeo de ideas tontas o malvadas en redes sociales, comentarios estúpidos junto a la máquina del café en la oficina, o tu cuñado cuando opina de lo que jamás experimentó. Nos …

author: Unknown
title: Festina Lente: "Lez bike, lê hêdî hêdî" an jî "Hêdî hêdî lez bike"
content:
“Tiştê ku bi lez tê avakirin, mayînde nabe; lê tiştê ku bi aqil, sebr û hişmendiyê tê avakirin, dikare bibe bingeha pêşerojeke mayînde.”


Di jiyana mirovan de her dem xwestekek heye ku em bigihîjin tiştên ku em dixwazin. Mirov dixwaze pêş bikeve, biguherê, bigihîje armancên xwe û di jiyana xwe de encamên mezin bistîne. Ev xwestek di xwezaya mirovan de heye. Lê pir caran di nav vê xwestekê de em rastiyeke girîng ji bîr dikin: Her tişt bi lez nayê bidestxistin û her gava bilez ne gaveke pêşketinê ye.


Em di serdemekê de dijîn ku her tişt dixwaze zû pêk were. Dem, zext, pêşbazî û xwesteka gihîştina encaman, mirovan dikin ku bêyî ku pir li ser encamên tevgerên xwe bifikirin, gav bavêjin. Lê jiyan, bi taybetî jiyana civakî, her tim bi lez û bez nayê rêvebirin. Tiştên ku bingehên wan kûr in, pêdiviya wan bi dem, sebr, aqil û têgihiştinê heye.


Festina lente

 gotineke Latînî ye ku wateya wê “

Hêdî hêdî bileze

” an jî “Bilez be, lê bi sebr û hişmendî tevbigere” ye. Ev gotin di xwe de paradoksekê, ango dijberiyeke xuya, dihewîne. Lê dema em kûrtir li wateya wê dinêrin, dibînin ku ev gotin ne tenê şêwazeke tevgerê ye, belkî felsefeyeke jiyanê ye.


Festina lente ji me re dibêje ku mirov divê di armancên xwe de biryardar û bi cesaret be, lê di rêya gihîştina wan de ji aqil, sebr û hişmendiyê dûr nekeve. Bilezbûn divê bi bêaqilî re neyê tevlihevkirin. Lez divê bi rêxistin, hesab, nirxandin û berpirsiyariyê re be. Ji ber ku a girîng ne tenê ew e ku em bigihîjin armancekê, a girîng ew e ku em bi çi awayî digihîjin wê armancê.


Di jiyanê de hin dem hene ku pêdivî bi bilez tevger kirinê heye. Hin dem jî hene ku rawestan, fikirîn û li ser biryarên xwe ji nû ve nihêrîn pêwîst e. Mirovê ku van her du deman baş nas dike, dikare bi awayekî serkeftî jiyana xwe birêve bibe.


Lezkirin carinan mirovan dixe nav biryarên şaş. Mirov bêyî ku şert û mercan baş binirxîne, ji aliyê hestên xwe ve tê birêvebirin. Lê sebra bêarmanc jî dikare bibe sedema rawestan û windakirina derfetên girîng. Ji ber vê yekê pêdivî bi hevsengiyekê heye: Ne bilezbûneke bêhiş û ne jî sebreke bêdawî; lê tevgeriyeke bi armanc, bi aqil û bi berpirsiyarî.


Festina lente hunera dîtina vê hevsengiyê ye. Ew hînî me dike ku kengê divê em gavên xwe bilez bikin û kengê divê em rawestin û ji nû ve bifikirin.


Ev felsefe tenê ji bo jiyana kesane nîne. Di jiyana civakî û di pêvajoyên guherînê de jî xwedî wateyeke kûr e.


Civak bi biryarên yek an çend kesan nayê avakirin. Civak ji mirovan, bîranînên wan, êşên wan, hêviyên wan, çand, ziman, nirx û têkiliyên wan pêk tê. Dema ku civakek derbasî pêvajoyeke nû dibe, divê hem rabirdûya xwe nas bike û hem jî pêşeroja xwe bi awayekî hişmendî ava bike.


Ji nû ve avakirina civakê tenê guhertina saziyên heyî nîne. Ew di heman demê de ji nû ve avakirina têkiliyên mirovan, zêdekirina baweriyê, bihêzkirina hişmendiya hevpar û pêşxistina çandeke nû ya hevjiyanê ye.


Civakek ku bi salan rastî şer, pevçûn, cudahî, bêbawerî û birîndarî bûye, nikare bi biryarekê hemû birînên xwe bide başkirin. Ji bo vê yekê pêdivî bi dem, guhdarîkirin, naskirina êşên hevdu, vegotina rastiyan û avakirina baweriyê heye.


Bawerî bi gotinan tenê nayê avakirin; bi tevgerên rast, bi edaletê, bi wekheviyê û bi berpirsiyariyê tê avakirin. Ji ber vê yekê pêvajoyên aştiyê divê ne tenê li ser peyman û biryarên siyasî bimînin, lê divê di nav civakê de jî bingehekî xurt bistînin.


Aştî tenê rawestandina şer û bêdengiya çekan nîne. Aştiya rastîn ew e ku mirov bikaribe bê tirs bijî, mafên xwe biparêze, bi nasname û çanda xwe bijî, bi dengê xwe bêje û bi kesên din re di çarçoveya rêzgirtin û wekheviyê de hevjiyanê bike.


Aştî pêvajoyeke civakî, exlaqî û mirovî ye. Ew pêdivî bi guhdarîkirina hevdu, qebûlkirina cudahiyan, edalet, maf û azadiyên bingehîn heye. Di vê pêvajoyê de divê mirov ji hişmendiya dijminatiyê derbasî hişmendiya hevjiyanê bibe.


Lê ev guherîn bi zorê û bi lez pêk nayê. Mirov nikare ji civakekê ku bi salan di nav bêbaweriyê de jiyaye, bixwaze ku di demeke kurt de hemû tiştan ji bîr bike. Divê êş bê guhdarîkirin, birîn bêne nasîn, bêedaletî bêne nirxandin û ji bo siberojeke dadwer  bê vekirin.


Li vir jî Festina lente wateya xwe dide: Ji bo avakirina aştiyê lez bike, lê ewqas jî hişmend be ku bingeha wê bi bawerî, edalet û rêzgirtinê were avakirin.


Her guherîneke mayînde berî her tiştî di hişmendiya mirovan de dest pê dike. Mirov divê pêşî xwe biguherîne, paşê dikare têkiliyên xwe û cîhana derdora xwe jî biguherîne.


Hînkirin û perwerdehiya civakî …

author: winter oak
title: The island that broke free
content:
A book review by Paul Cudenec, who reads it

here


“Every word that comes from your speaking hole is a lie in some form”. [1]


“You, the self-designated Elite of this planet, brought to your position moreso by your own lack of what is understood in most places as morality and your willingness over millennia to steal and cheat and perform the most barbaric crimes… have betrayed your trust about as fully as any trust could be betrayed”. [2]


Dave Patterson does not mince his words in

Greenways

 – the first of two “

Green Island

” books – which although a work of fiction features a large amount of truth.


The basis of the novel is that Prince Edward Island in eastern Canada has partly broken away from the rest of the country after a surprise election result that ended the old two-party hold on power.


It has renamed itself Green Island and started organising society in a very different way to the previous status quo.


Now, the description of a stable and mainly happy society (not quite a Utopia, but heading that way) could have been as dull as ditchwater over the nearly 600 pages of Patterson’s work.


But he does a great job in making the book a lively read. For a start, his style (or styles, because he adopts many different registers according to who is speaking or writing) is one of anything but terse concision – ebullient eloquence would be nearer the mark and there is plenty of humour as well.


Neither is Patterson of the social realist school, as evidenced by the way that the island attracts the interest and presence of

Henry David Thoreau

, [3] Thomas More, Thomas Paine and Che Guevera and that the trial of the global elite featured in the opening citations is conducted by a divine presence called The One, accompanied by the blindfolded figure of Justice herself.


There are several distinct threads advancing through the pages, including chapters consisting of fragments and thought-provoking quotations from famous thinkers.


I will share a few of the latter to give you a flavour:


“Do not go where the path may lead; go instead where there is no path and leave a trail”. Ralph Waldo Emerson. [4]


“Whatever you do will seem insignificant, but it is very important to do it”.

Mohandas Gandhi

. [5]


“Justice is conscience, not a personal conscience but the conscience of the whole of humanity. Those who clearly recognize the voice of their own conscience usually recognize also the voice of justice”. Alexander Solzhenitsyn. [6]


“The trade of governing has always been monopolised by the most ignorant and the most rascally individuals of mankind”. Thomas Paine. [7]


“When plunder becomes a way of life for a group of men living in society, they create for themselves, in the course of time, a legal system that authorizes it and a moral code that glorifies it”. Frédéric Bastiat. [8]


But there is also plenty of wisdom in

Greenways

 to be found coming from the mouths, pens and keyboards of its various characters, all of which can of course be regarded as

Dave Patterson

 quotations. Here are some of them:


“Strength guided by a reptilian mind is not conducive to advanced civilization”. [9]


“At all times the power of a tiny point of Light is such that it will dissipate darkness all around, but the power of a tiny point of darkness in a place where there is Light is insignificant”. [10]


“I remember still when we had plenty and freedom in our village here, and happiness and security and a good life in our families, and no ruler… It was a simpler life, to be sure, but one I know most would joyfully return to, rather than what we have now”. [11]


“After a certain period of training, the people embrace their chains, they love their chains, they hate those who try to free them!” [12]


That last one reminds me of the multiple occasions when I would be using a day off work (Saturdays, usually) to make a stand for freedom, only for some chain-loving passer-by to angrily call out: “

Getta job!

“.


Only five years into their new era, the islanders’ world is still not too different from our own, although they are proud to be “turning back some of the less pleasant aspects of modern industrial society”. [13]


Traffic has been reduced because of “a good reliable public transport system” [14] and they enjoy permaculture and organic market gardens. [15]


Since Green Island is a real democracy I find myself hoping that they will reverse themselves yet further out of the industrial dead-end and collectively …

author: Duda Sousa
title: Agenda da semana: Câmara vota ajuste fiscal de Lula e STF debate direitos indígenas
content:
A Câmara dos Deputados começa a semana com a apreciação e votação do polêmico pacote de ajuste fiscal apresentado pelo governo Lula.

 O presidente da Casa, Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), convocou uma sessão extraordinária para esta segunda-feira (23), às 18h, com o objetivo de iniciar a análise do

Projeto de Lei Complementar

 (PLP) 299/2026, aprovado pelo Senado na última quarta-feira (18). O governo pretende concluir a votação na Câmara sem alterações no texto, evitando que a proposta precise retornar aos senadores.


Conhecido como plano Moretti, em referência ao ministro do Planejamento e Orçamento, Bruno Moretti, o projeto amplia os mecanismos de controle das despesas públicas. Entre as medidas estão a possibilidade de novos bloqueios de recursos, a redução de benefícios tributários e a diminuição, em determinadas condições, do limite de crescimento real dos gastos federais de 2,5% para 2%. O governo estima que as mudanças possam melhorar o resultado das contas públicas em até R$ 56,1 bilhões em 2027.


No Senado, a Comissão de Educação e Cultura deve discutir, na quarta-feira (25), as prioridades orçamentárias para a educação em 2027.

 Até o meio-dia desta segunda, os parlamentares poderão apresentar sugestões de emendas à Lei de Diretrizes Orçamentárias (LDO), que orienta a elaboração do orçamento federal. Encerrado esse prazo, caberá à comissão analisar as propostas recebidas e decidir quais serão aprovadas para encaminhamento à Comissão Mista de Orçamento do Congresso Nacional.


No Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), os ministros têm julgamentos previstos para quarta e quinta-feira, dias 25 e 26, envolvendo direitos dos povos indígenas e proteção ambiental.

Uma das ações questiona a exigência de consulta prévia às comunidades indígenas antes da realização de obras públicas que possam afetá-las, como a construção de estradas e a instalação de redes de energia elétrica. A Corte também deverá analisar dispositivos da Lei da Liberdade Econômica que permitem a autorização de atividades mesmo diante de possíveis impactos socioambientais. Outro julgamento previsto envolve as regras para a execução obrigatória de emendas parlamentares nos orçamentos estaduais.


De volta ao Brasil após compromissos internacionais, Lula terá pela frente as negociações para aprovar o ajuste fiscal e as articulações sobre a composição do governo para seu próximo mandato. Na última quinta-feira (19), o presidente assinou o decreto que regulamenta a nova escala de trabalho de cinco dias de atividade e dois de descanso, encerrando a

escala 6×1

. A implementação da medida e a tramitação das propostas econômicas continuam entre os principais desafios políticos do Planalto.


Estão na agenda da semana de 23 a 27 de novembro:


DIREITOS HUMANOS


Câmara


Comissão Nacional Indígena da Verdade (CPOVOS, 24/11, 15h30):

 A Comissão realiza audiência pública sobre a criação de uma Comissão Nacional Indígena da Verdade. O debate abordará políticas de memória, justiça e reparação pelas violações de direitos cometidas contra povos indígenas, além de medidas para evitar que esses episódios se repitam. 


Violência sexual infantil e inteligência artificial (CEXEXPLO, 25/11, 14h):

 Audiência discute o uso de tecnologias para produzir e compartilhar materiais de abuso sexual infantil, incluindo imagens geradas por inteligência artificial. Representantes da Polícia Federal, do Unicef e de organizações de proteção à infância foram convidados para o debate.


Rede de proteção à infância (CEXEXPLO, 26/11, 9h):

 A comissão debate a distribuição e o funcionamento dos serviços de proteção de crianças e adolescentes no país. A audiência abordará a atuação dos conselhos tutelares, dos Centros de Referência Especializados de Assistência Social (Creas) e das delegacias especializadas, incluindo as dificuldades de atendimento em regiões com menor presença dessas instituições.


Mães atípicas (CDHMIR, 26/11, 14h):

 Parlamentares debatem as dificuldades enfrentadas por mães de pessoas com deficiência. A audiência, solicitada pela deputada Erika Kokay (PT-DF), terá representantes de movimentos sociais e órgãos públicos para discutir políticas de cuidado e proteção social.


MEIO AMBIENTE


Câmara


Educação ambiental e mudanças climáticas (CMADS, 26/11, 14h):

 A Comissão realiza seminário sobre o papel da educação ambiental no enfrentamento das emergências climáticas e dos eventos extremos no Brasil. O debate contará com representantes do Ministério do Meio …

author: Unknown
title: Adresse à notre bon maître La Boétie
content:
La Boétie, un moyen pour la bourgeoisie de se défausser sur le peuple de ses propres crimes et iniquités.


Dans la présentation de l'édition chez Payot (1976) du Discours de la servitude volontaire, Miguel Abensour et Marcel Gauchet commencent par noter que ce texte est considéré comme «

 

transparent quant au sens

 

». «

 

Présupposé de lecture universellement admis, ajoutent-ils. Machiavel vient-il en question, par exemple, il est classique de s'interroger pour décider s'il écrit à l'intention des tyrans ou, à l'inverse, de ceux qui ne savent pas afin de les éclairer. S'agissant de La Boétie, par contre, il n'y aurait pas lieu de se perdre en conjectures sur le sens de sa démonstration, ni sur les destinataires du Discours. Sans équivoque aucune, La Boétie écrirait du côté de la démocratie pour le peuple.

 

»


C'est ainsi donc que revoilà La Boétie sur les barricades. Enfin, son nom. Et le titre de son discours. Car La Boétie, lui, n'est jamais descendu dans la rue pour protester, ni pacifiquement, ni violemment. Il n'a non plus jamais eu faim, jamais eu besoin de travailler dur pour gagner sa vie, jamais eu de famille à prendre en charge, jamais eu à manquer d'un enseignement de qualité. Il est né dans une famille de magistrats, il a fait de brillantes études, bénéficié d'une dérogation du roi pour entrer comme conseiller au Parlement de Bordeaux deux ans avant l'âge légal. Il n'est donc pas surprenant qu'il trouve «

 

chose vraiment surprenante

 

» que «

 

tant d'hommes, tant de villes, tant de nations supportent quelquefois tout d'un Tyran seul, qui n'a de puissance que celle qu'on lui donne, qui n'a pouvoir de leur nuire qu'autant qu'ils veulent bien l'endurer.

 

» Car lui n'a connu que les privilèges de sa condition.


Désolée cher Étienne si bien né, si bien intentionné, mais apprends un peu la vie du peuple avant de parler. On voit bien que tu n'as pas été réprimé, violenté, mutilé, persécuté, torturé ou assassiné par les polices, les milices et les armées d'un tyran, pour penser qu'il est seul et sans pouvoir contre le peuple. Tu vois Étienne, ce qui me dérange, c'est que, n'ayant jamais eu à subir ce genre de choses – tant mieux pour toi

 

! – tu vois les peuples comme «

 

des millions de millions d'hommes, misérablement asservis, et soumis tête baissée, à un joug déplorable, non qu'ils y soient contraints par une force majeure, mais parce qu'ils sont fascinés et, pour ainsi dire, ensorcelés par le seul nom d'un

 

». Pardon pour ma familiarité, monsieur de La Boétie, mais je voudrais t'y voir, toi

 

!


Pourtant tu n'as pas complètement tort. Je vois bien que, fascinés par ton seul nom, passé de génération en génération sans que personne, comme le notent les préfaciers précités, n'interroge vraiment ta parole, certains aspirants révolutionnaires se soumettent à ton autorité, parce que les y embrigadent d'autres prestigieux personnages, qu'ils soient intellectuels, leaders politiques ou simplement professeurs chargés d'enseigner à des lycéens le programme, dont tu fais partie (crois-moi, tu ne serais pas au programme si le ministère te percevait comme dangereux pour l'ordre établi

 

!). Je dis bien certains et non pas tous les révolutionnaires. Car la vérité c'est que les vrais révolutionnaires, ceux qui agissent, se soucient peu de te lire, ou de s'entendre dire par toi qu'il suffit de vouloir être libre pour l'être – alors que pour libérer l'humanité ils endurent des difficultés dont tu n'as pas la moindre idée.


Il paraît que tu as écrit ton brillant petit texte à peine sorti de l'adolescence. Un garçon intelligent, nul doute là-dessus. Né et grandi à l'abri de tout. Avec un tout petit peu d'expérience de la vie, comment aurais-tu pu écrire des choses aussi naïves

 

? Croire que le tyran est seul contre tous, et que puisqu'il est «

 

le plus efféminé de la nation

 

», il est aisé de le faire tomber

 

! Mon ami, on voit que tu n'as jamais été une femme, ni un pauvre, ni un colonisé. Tu donnes des leçons de révolution comme les curés donnent aux jeunes mariés des leçons de sexualité. Dommage que tu n'aies pu rencontrer Rimbaud plutôt que Montaigne : il a su plus tard, lui, qu' «

 

on n'est pas sérieux quand on a dix-sept ans

 

». Mais non, ce n'est pas de ta faute. La faute en est aux adultes qui continuent à te prendre au sérieux quand ils prétendent défendre le peuple alors que dans ta naïveté d'enfant gâté, tu ne fais que culpabiliser le peuple en le …

title: Les Bestiales #3 du 24 février au 1er mars 2027 à Bure (55)
content:
Les bestiales sont des rencontres antispécistes qui auront lieu à Bure en Meuse (55). Bure est un lieu de lutte contre un projet de méga-poubelle nucléaire.


Les bestiales sont des rencontres antispécistes. Les deux premières éditions ont eu lieu en 2023 et en 2025 à Bure. La troisième édition aura lieu du 24 février au 1

er

 mars 2027 également à Bure, plus précisément à la maison de résistance à la poubelle nucléaire, 2 rue de l'Église 55290 Bure.


Les luttes ont tendance à être vues sous des angles purement utilitariste vis à vis des êtres humain.es. alors que les grands projets de bétonisation se font au détriment des espèces qui vivent déjà dans ces environnements et contribuent à détruire les espaces de vie, de trajet, d'alimentation de tout les animaux. En projetant de sacrifier tout un territoire à la folie nucléaire sans tenir compte de tou.tes ses habitant.es – humain.es et non humain.es -, le projet de poubelle nucléaire à Bure s'inscrit complètement dans une vision spéciste. C'est pourquoi les Bestiales reviennent à Bure après les deux premières éditions en 2023 et 2025.


Nous avons l'impression qu'au milieu des urgences écologiques, antifascistes, décoloniales, etc, il est parfois dur de prendre le temps de discuter/réfléchir/agir sur des luttes tout autant centrales et entremêlées telles que l'antispécisme (et l'antinucléaire). En hiver, il fait froid, il ne se passe pas grand-chose, alors pourquoi pas se retrouver en Meuse pour se rencontrer, partager, échanger autour de l'antispécisme

 

?


Nous voyons le spécisme comme une oppression systémique qui se nourrit et qui nourrit d'autres oppressions, imbriquées les unes aux autres, aussi, nos envies pour ces rencontres est d'avoir une approche anti-autoritaire, anticapitaliste et une organisation autogestionnaire. Une attention sera portée à ne pas véhiculer d'oppressions systémiques.


Toutes les informations utiles pour venir à l'événement (infos pratiques, programmation, accessibilité) sont sur notre site bureburebure.info :

les bestiales #3 sur bureburebure

. On peut y trouver notamment un formulaire de préinscription anonyme et facultatif accessible en suivant ce lien :

https://forms.42l.fr/apps/forms/is4acmzMzBxb8Ett

author: Unknown
title: Grèves novembre-décembre 1995 : « savoir s'appuyer sur nos expériences, mémoires et acquis collectifs »
content:
Le 15 novembre 1995, un peu plus de 6 mois après l'élection de Jacques Chirac, commençait chez les cheminot·e·s, puis dans toute la fonction publique, un mouvement social d'ampleur : les grèves de novembre-décembre en opposition au Plan Juppé qui proposait d'aligner le fonctionnement des retraites du public sur celui du privé.


Malgré la trahison des syndicats, ce mouvement a été combattif et victorieux.


Article initialement paru sur le site

Critique sociale.info


Le mouvement de novembre-décembre 1995, vingt ans après


Il y a vingt ans se déroulait l'une des plus puissantes luttes sociales qui ait eu lieu en France au cours de ces dernières décennies. En novembre et décembre 1995, des millions de grévistes et de manifestants se mobilisaient notamment contre le projet du Premier ministre Alain Juppé de contre-réforme des retraites. Nous publions ci-dessous trois témoignages de participants au mouvement : un cheminot, un étudiant, un enseignant.


C. M :


Quelles ont été les pratiques d'auto-organisation là où tu étais, auxquelles tu as participé

 

?


En 1995, j'étais cheminot à la gare de Lyon, où je bossais alors depuis 19 ans. J'étais un des animateurs du syndicat régional

CFDT

, majoritaire à la gare de Lyon. Je donne ces quelques éléments, pour situer d'où je parle à propos de la grève reconductible de novembre-décembre 1995.


À la

SNCF

, ce n'est pas 1995 qui a marqué l'apparition (ou le retour) à des pratiques d'auto-organisation de la lutte. Neuf ans plus tôt, les trois semaines de grève de décembre 1986-janvier 1987 avaient permis d'imposer une rupture nette avec un système où la grève était devenue depuis longtemps l'affaire des syndicats, voire même des seules fédérations syndicales dès lors qu'on parlait de mouvement national.


La grève de 1986-1987 se situe dans une période de forte tension sociale : mouvement lycéen et étudiant contre la loi Devaquet, assassinat de Malik Oussekine par la police, grève des agents commerciaux de la

SNCF

 puis grève des agents de conduite, qui se transforment rapidement en grève intercatégorielle sur l'ensemble de l'entreprise. De sa préparation à sa conclusion, ce mouvement est placé sous la responsabilité des assemblées générales de grévistes

 

; c'est un acquis important qui se retrouvera «

 

naturellement

 

» lors du démarrage de la grève 1995, avec une différence de taille : en 1986, si les collectifs

CFDT

-cheminots sont souvent à l'initiative du mouvement, les militants et militantes

CGT

 combattent la grève dans ses premiers jours puis s'y insèrent de manière fort maladroite vis-à-vis des assemblées générales

 

; en 1995, du côté de la

CGT

 la leçon a été retenue.


Cette pratique des assemblées générales est bien sûr essentielle. Encore faut-il s'entendre sur ce qu'est une

AG

 de grévistes. Ce n'est pas une réunion d'information organisée par les syndicats, c'est bien un moment où chacun et chacune doit pouvoir se sentir suffisamment à l'aise pour parler, pour proposer, pour critiquer, pour décider. En 1986-1987 comme en 1995, la quasi-totalité des

AG

 au sein de la

SNCF

 se font sur la base du collectif de travail : le dépôt, l'atelier, la gare, le chantier de ventes ou de manœuvre lorsqu'il s'agit de gros établissements. C'est à cette échelle qu'on a réellement des

AG

. Il ne s'agit pas de «

 

meetings

 

» où les porte-paroles des syndicats, fussent-ils des représentants ou représentantes locaux, donnent les nouvelles, appellent à reconduire le mouvement ou à l'arrêter, avant que la démocratie se limite à lever la main pour approuver ce qui vient d'être dit.


C'est cette pratique de véritables assemblées générales où chaque gréviste peut aisément trouver sa place qui permet une appropriation de la grève par les grévistes

 

; d'où les multiples initiatives autogérées, parfois formalisées sous forme de «

 

commissions

 

» : pour la revue de presse quotidienne, pour les repas, pour les propositions d'actions, pour les liens avec les autres

AG

, etc. C'est de là que se feront «

 

naturellement

author: Kate Doherty
title: Reproductive rights under threat in Newcastle
content:
"Religion has no place in healthcare!" "You have the power to do something about this!" These words were shouted at Labor MP Jodie Harrison as she was booed offstage at a pro-choice rally on 8 November. Almost a thousand people filled Newcastle's Civic Park to protest against the imminent takeover of a local hospital by an organisation of Catholic bigots.

In May 2025, Healthscope, a nationwide for-profit hospital operator, collapsed. Its 32 hospitals were put up for sale, and 14 are set to be acquired by Calvary Health Care. Calvary is a Catholic organisation that enforces a "morality" code banning abortion, IVF and gender-affirming care, and

 

has even denied

 women urgent care for incomplete miscarriages.

The effects will be particularly devastating in Newcastle. Two of the city's private hospitals will come under Calvary's management at the end of November. One of these, Newcastle Private, is the only dedicated maternity hospital between Sydney and the Queensland border. More than 1,600 women give birth there every year, and it's a key provider of reproductive healthcare in the region.

Calvary has

 

already confirmed

 its "code of ethics" will be enforced at Newcastle Private, meaning even contraception won’t be offered. Labor health minister Ryan Park

 

defended the transfer, saying the state government had deemed Calvary fit to hold a license, and had no power to decide what services a private hospital would deliver.

Newcastle's public hospitals are in no condition to accept an influx of patients forced out by Calvary. The John Hunter Hospital is

 

overcrowded and understaffed

, experiencing bed shortages of 40 and 65 every day. The Mater Hospital up the road is

 

infested with lethal mould

—and already run by Calvary. If the sale goes ahead, women in Newcastle may be forced to travel to Sydney to access reproductive procedures.

This raises the question: why are women and LGBTI people so dependent on private healthcare in the first place?

The answer is neoliberalism. Both parties, Labor and Liberal, have spent the past forty years dismantling public healthcare and creating in its place a two-tier system. The logic given is that public hospitals are there for emergencies, so it's fine for "optional" elective procedures to be take care of in the private system. But not all urgent care is considered as such by our stretched public hospitals—even life-saving procedures for women are treated as though they were optional indulgences.

In NSW, less than 4 percent of abortions take place in public hospitals. Abortion was only decriminalised here in 2019, and only three of the state's public hospitals even routinely offer it. Most women are forced to "opt" for private care and pay

 

exorbitant costs

. Access to IVF through the public system is similarly limited by the appalling wait list of up to eighteen months. Women shunted onto the private system can suddenly lose access if their care isn't profitable enough, with ten private maternity wards

 

having closed

 over the past three years alone.

The effects of health privatisation on women are worsened by other aspects of our structural oppression. Because women in Australia are paid 71 cents for every dollar a man is paid, every expense is more financially onerous. Women are more likely to be financially dependent on a partner, imperilling their ability to access and make decisions about their reproductive health. Higher petrol prices increase the cost of long-distance travel. For a working-class woman in a regional area, reproductive freedom lies behind a gauntlet of financial barriers.

The NSW government should cancel the transfer of Newcastle Private to Calvary and instead take the hospital into public hands. The right of women and LGBTI people to access healthcare shouldn't hinge on their ability to pay, let alone on someone's twisted sense of morality. Socialists in Newcastle will keep fighting for a fully public healthcare system—one designed around the needs of all people, with no place for religious bigotry or the profit motive.

 

Kate Doherty 

is the NSW Socialists candidate for Newcastle’s Wallsend in the upcoming 2027 state election.

title: Qehreman Osman: Em ê lobiyeke xurt ji bo her çar perçeyên Kurdistanê ava bikin
content:
Qehreman Osman, berpirsê Nivîsîngeha Şefa Barzanî, Serpereştyarê Giştî yê Revenda Kurdistanî li Baregeha Barzanî, di dema birêveçûna Sêyemîn Konferansa Kurdên Qefqazê li Tiflîsa, paytexta Gurcistanê de ragihand, armanca wan a sereke parastina ziman û çanda Kurdên diyasporayê ye ji bişaftinê û kar ji bo avakirina lobî û piştevaniyeke xurt ji bo her çar perçeyên Kurdistanê dikin, da ku revenda Kurdî li welatên cîhanê bibe hêzeke bibandor ji bo xizmeta doza neteweyî. Qehreman Osman, di dema beşdarbûna di gera nûçeyî ya Kurdistan TV de ragihand, di panelên konferansê de nûner û zanayên olî yên hemû pêkhateyên Mesîhî, Cihû, Misilman, Êzidî, Elewî û Yarsan beşdar bûn û bi awayekî şefaf û dûr ji tirsê gotûbêjên aştiyane û biratî pêk anîn. Her wiha amaje bi wê yekê kir ku beşdarên konferansê ji Amerîka, Kanada, Ewropa û her çar perçeyên Kurdistanê ve, ligel beşdarên Kurdistana Sor ku wekî perçeyê pêncem tê binavkirin, civiyan. Armanca sereke ya vê konferansê jî gihandina wê peyamê ye ku cudahiya ol û baweriyan divê nebe sedema çêbûna nakokiyan di pirsa neteweyî de, ji ber ku mirov dikare ola xwe biguherîne, lê nikare netewe û zimanê xwe biguherîne. Biryar e piştî bidawîbûna konferansê, pêşniyar û peyameke fermî ji aliyên olî û siyasî yên Kurdistanê re bê şandin. Di derbarê rola Konfederasyona Revenda Kurdistanî de, Qehreman Osman eşkere kir ku ji %80 zêdetir komele û rêxistinên bibandor ên revenda Kurdistanî yên li derveyî welat di çarçoveya federasyonên konfederasyonê de kom bûne. Armanca sereke jî parastina Kurdên diyasporayê ye ji bişaftinê, parastina ziman û çanda Kurdî, di heman demê de tevlîbûna wan a erênî bi civaka welatên mazûvan re, heta ku bigihîjin asteke bilind û bibin lobî û piştevaniyeke xurt ji bo her çar perçeyên Kurdistanê. Konfederasyona Revenda Kurdistanî bi destpêşxeriya Serok Barzanî ji bo komkirina Kurdistaniyên diyasporayê bi hemû reng, deng û olên cuda ve di bin sîwana Ala Kurdistanê de hatiye damezrandin. Di vê çarçoveyê de, Konferansa Kurdên Qefqazê sê sal e li pey hev li bajarê Tiflîsa, paytexta Gurcistanê tê lidarxistin û beşdarbûna Kurdistaniyan tê de sal bi sal zêde dibe. Li gorî gotina amadekarên konferansê, heta sê-çar sal berê Kurdên niştecî yên Gurcistanê ji aliyê neteweyî ve qut bûbûn û Ala Kurdistanê li wî welatî nedihate dîtin. Lê niha bi saya vekirina baregeha fermî ya Komeleya Ronahî ya ser bi Konfederasyona Revenda Kurdistanî ve û bilindkirina Ala Kurdistanê, rêbazeke zelal ji bo girêdana Kurdên wê herêmê bi ax û nasnameya wan a neteweyî ve hatiye avakirin.

author: Pip Hinman
title: Labor’s new ‘defence’ bill a threat to democracy
content:
The federal government's new “defence” bill shows the lengths to which Labor is prepared to serve its senior partners in AUKUS, particularly the United States.

The Defence Legislation Amendment (Accelerating Capability and Protecting Bases) Bill 2026, which passed the Senate on November 19 with support of the Coalition, One Nation, Jacqui Lambie and Ralph Babet, hands “extraordinary new powers” to the defence minister, foreign militaries and private companies, Amnesty International said.

David Pocock, Lidia Thorpe, Fatima Payman and the nine Greens Senators opposed the bill in the Senate, and every crossbench MP backed the call for a longer inquiry.

The bill expands the defence minister’s power to establish “security zones”, which restrict public access to places it has designated to be areas of national security. The minister can authorise a senior public servant to simply declare any sea, land or airspace a “defence security zone”.

It allows the minister to override state and territory laws.

It introduces draconian penalties — including up to 15 years’ imprisonment — for “a person who commits an offence”. Activists, journalists and anyone else who stumbles anywhere near these security zones can be criminalised.

Amnesty said people could be detained even though they may not know the exact boundaries of the declared security zones.

Defence minister Richard Marles is trying to downplay the bill’s reach and significance. But he admits the bill is aimed at squaring Australian laws with the government’s commitment to the US and British war pact, known as AUKUS Pillar I and II. As he put it: “Australia’s strategic circumstances demand urgency.”

Labor has avoided taking the unpopular AUKUS deal to an election. It has also restricted parliamentary scrutiny on this controversial bill to just a few days.

The Point has listed six alarming aspects of this bill. They include giving the minister and certain public servants the power to make “capability declarations” which override state, territory and federal laws. These declarations do not have to be made publicly available. They can facilitate weapons testing — including by foreign militaries.

A public servant could “switch off” state laws so that a foreign military could test their weapons here. The bill does not specify which laws can be overridden, but as The Point notes, it will be the “inconvenient” ones such as environment or heritage protections.

The penalties for those wishing to protest are steep: fines range from about $4000 to more than $150,000; 37 of the offences appear to carry prison sentences, ranging from 12 months to 15 years.

“Most of those offences include ‘strict liability’ or ‘absolute liability’ for some elements. This means that prosecutors only need to prove that you did something, not that you meant to do it. It also means that very few defences are available.”

You can be “reasonably suspected” of committing an offence in relation to a defence zone and be detained, including by a weapons’ contractor for the Department of Defence.

Lawyer Rita Jabri Markwell has also pointed out that the bill dovetails with Labor’s ambition for artificial intelligence data centres and AI’s role in the Five Eyes’ surveillance work. She said the new law will make it “harder to hold universities to account for their complicity in developing technology that enables companies and forces to commit war crimes”.

It will also make it harder for Traditional Owners to stop weapons testing on Country; to stop the contamination of their land and water and for any of their Country to be used to store radioactive waste. The First Nations fact sheet makes clear that the Woomera Prohibited Area remains a military zone, despite local First Nations opposition.

The bill’s amendments affect 14 laws, including freedom of information laws, and laws relating to the National Anti-Corruption Commission and the Criminal Code.

Labor can ram its bill through the House of Representatives this week because it has Coalition and One Nation support. But it will only deepen and increase the anger over the AUKUS pact and Labor’s decision that, no matter the political and economic cost to the country, relations with Donald Trump’s administration remain sacrosanct.

author: Unknown
title: Ephéméride des luttes : 23 novembre
content:
Aujourd'hui 23 novembre, l'éphéméride des luttes est antifasciste et antinucléaire et est bien consciente que la police est une institution au service de nos cauchemars. Elle est donc tratiée comme telle.


1963 :

 Aux États-Unis, le Président démocrate Kennedy est assassiné au cours du cortège présidentiel.


1977 :

 300 étudiants encerclent le bâtiment de la scolarité à l'université de Vincennes et séquestrent le président Merlin qui est molesté en public en même temps que trois vigiles, après avoir tenté de s'échapper.


1984 :

 A Blagnac (banlieue de Toulouse), explosion au bar Le Deauville, qui devait héberger le soir même une soirée d'extrême-droite.


2011 :

 A Valogne dans la manche, une mobilisation antinucléaire tente de bloquer un train chargé de déchets nucléaires qui traverse le pays en direction de l'Allemagne. De durs affrontements ont lieu dès les premières heures du jour. Un camion chargé de matériel et de victuailles pour les CRS est incendié, ainsi qu'un transformateur. Au final, le train mettra plus de trois jours à arriver à destination.


2012 :

 Affrontements avec la police sur la ZAD de Notre-Dame-des-Landes lors de la destruction de la Chateigne, construite la semaine précédente au cours de la manifestation de réoccupation qui avait réunit 40.000 personnes. Manuel Valls, ministre de l'Intérieur, déclare « Il est hors de question de laisser un kyste s'organiser... ». C'est raté.


 Dans le centre de rétention de Komotini (Κομοτηνή) en Grèce, une grande révolte a lieu, impliquant de très nombreux migrants. La police fait massivement usage de lacrymogènes.


2014 :

 - A Thessalonique, des anarchistes font sauter des explosifs composés de bonbonnes de gaz au domicile du président du syndicat de policiers de la ville.


 A Athènes, le groupe 'nuits de feu' incendie des distributeurs de billets et solidarité avec la grève de la faim de Nikos Romanos et Yannis Michailidis, anarchistes en prison.

content:
Ultimi preparativi Zapatisti per l’Incontro Abbraccio con le Famiglie Buscadoras. Parte 8: Qua e Là

Sorelle Famiglie in Cerca di verità e giustizia:

Vi mandiamo i nostri saluti e rispetti.

Credo che questo sia l’ultimo testo che pubblichiamo prima della partenza. La delegazione ha terminato i preparativi ed è tornata a casa per salutare tutti e sbrigare le ultime faccende.

Siamo già impegnati a preparare tutto e a organizzarci per partire il 28 novembre alla volta di Città del Messico.

Prima, il 27 novembre, presso il CIDECI di San Cristóbal de las Casas, avremo i primi incontri riservati con i collettivi e le Familias Buscadoras in Chiapas.

Ecco quindi come stanno le cose ad oggi:

La delegazione zapatista si concentrerà al CIDECI il 26 novembre e ci organizzeremo per la prima sessione il 27 e per partire il 28.

Familias Buscadoras registrate presso il Frayba: 544. Si tratta di 476 donne, 63 uomini e 5 otroas. Non citeremo i nomi dei collettivi né delle persone, per tutelare la loro sicurezza a causa delle minacce che ricevono.

Si sono registrate le seguenti geografie: Jalisco, Città del Messico, Guanajuato, Tamaulipas, Coahuila, Sonora, Oaxaca, Stato del Messico, Veracruz, Colima, Michoacán, Querétaro, Baja California del Sud, Baja California, Chihuahua, Guerrero, Chiapas, Morelos, Nuevo León, Sinaloa, Puebla, San Luis Potosí, Yucatán, Aguascalientes, Quintana Roo, Nayarit e Durango.

Data di chiusura parziale delle iscrizioni: 22 novembre 2026, ore 23:59

Data di ripresa delle iscrizioni (questo avverrà quando saremo presso la base operativa a Città del Messico, nella Casa de los Pueblos “Samir Flores Soberanes”): dal 2 dicembre 2026 al 4 gennaio 2027.

È tutto. Ecco un breve video del Comando Palomitas che si è stufato di stare in fase di preparazione e ha deciso di anticipare i tempi, portando tortillas di fango, pozol, gomme da masticare e cose del genere in casse senza ruote. Hanno detto che sarebbero andati avanti a piedi. Niente paura. Non sono arrivati al cancello principale. Il motivo? Hanno finito le gomme da masticare e sono tornati indietro per rifornirsi.

Dalle montagne del Sud-est Messicano.

Video dedicato alle ballerine, ballerini e bailarinoas del Taller Coreográfico della UNAM (TCUNAM) che sono più di qualche calzamaglia, ma vabbè, pazienza. La burocrazia della UNAM sembra dimenticare che la «U» sta per università, ovvero universalità. E non avrebbero potuto avere un pubblico più degno di quello che hanno bloccato. Speriamo che ci riescano.

title: Preparativi in corso laggiù.
content:
Vi informiamo di ciò che ci viene riferito, – beh, “ci viene comunicato” -, da tutto il gruppo che si sta dando da fare per rendere possibile l’abbraccio tra voi e noi, i popoli zapatisti. E tutte, tutti e todoas vi abbracciano.

Cibo. – La “Casa de los Pueblos Samir Flores Soberanes” fungerà da mensa principale per le famiglie Buscadoras, oltre ad altri due locali che sono in fase di allestimento. Non servono né generi alimentari né cuochi. Solo i soldi per l’acquisto quotidiano dei prodotti deperibili.

Trasporti. – Chi ha messo a disposizione veicolo e autista per accompagnare le famiglie buscadoras a Città del Messico, è pregato di registrarsi qui: transportegira26@gmail.com 5510175353 Con Melva Vázquez

Chiediamo a tutti gli artisti di ogni genere e a chi si occupa di sport di riprogrammare, se possibile, le proprie iniziative o di elaborarne di nuove, da realizzarsi tra il 15 e il 30 dicembre.

In quelle date avremo meno impegni e potremo unirci a voi e partecipare insieme a voi. Concerti, balli, danza, teatro, sport, partitelle, tornei di indovinelli e tutte quelle cose che voi ben conoscete. Nei luoghi che preferite e dove vi è possibile. Per quanto riguarda il trasporto, ne parleremo in seguito.

Beh, visto che ci saranno delle famiglie buscadoras da quelle parti, perché non organizzare una Posada mega-super-iper-combo con la domanda chiave: “Dove sono?”

Vedete un po’ voi. È la geografia ed è il calendario della creatività e dell’ingegno. Ognuno lo viva a modo suo. Non aspettatevi registrazioni e cose del genere. Non serve alcun permesso per l’arte e lo sport. Organizzazione collettiva e autonomia.

Dalle montagne del Sud-est Messicano.
